newsitem.title: GERMANY: FAG Kugelfischer sees profit rising in 1997.
newsitem.headline: FAG Kugelfischer sees profit rising in 1997.

text.p: German ball-bearing maker FAG Kugelfischer AG said on Tuesday that it was aiming for a 12 percent return on capital by the year 2000 and expected profit and cash flow to rise in 1997.
The company reported a rise in group net profit for 1996 to 106 million marks ($61.3 million) from 101 million. It raised its dividend payout to 50 pfennigs from 40 pfennigs a year earlier.
Group earnings per share eased however to 1.75 marks from 1.84 marks.
The company also said that its ordinary earnings eased to 23 million marks from 25 million marks in the first quarter of the current year.
